currentUiRequirements: Home cumulative and venue metrics use the ten-year completed model, not legacy frozen metrics.
Home years are newest-first; months and dates remain chronological as currently implemented.
Finished historical races are labeled 的中, 不的中, 見送り, or 返還 where applicable; 不的中 is red and 返還 is distinct.
Frozen archive canonical skips remain skips even if legacy D1 public-bet rows exist for the same race.

Public HTML uses reader-facing Japanese instead of internal shorthand. In particular, T-minus labels are rendered as 発走N分前, prediction probabilities and recent-result learning are explained in plain Japanese, and fallback/SLA implementation terms are not exposed as unexplained UI jargon.
The public prediction-logic page is labeled 予想のしくみ and explains the completed model in product-ready Japanese while preserving methodology transparency.

The public prediction-logic and guide pages explain that the frozen completed base model is combined with continuous recency learning that incorporates same-day finished races and settled bets before each later prediction.

Public methodology states that JRA official odds are the only allowed market odds, synthetic/estimated/probability-derived substitute odds are forbidden, and missing official odds fails closed instead of fabricating a final bet.
Live selected-race pages use three compact tabs: 予想買い目, 買い目の理由, 出走馬. Only one of these long sections is shown at a time on the race detail page.

The 買い目の理由 tab explains only why the final two tickets were selected. It shows each ticket's estimated combination hit probability, JRA official odds, probability-times-odds value, and a plainly labeled ticket evaluation score, plus the actual narrowing sequence.
Race-selection rationale, raceScore, selection proxy tickets, selection-stage ROI components, and generic condition-match copy are not shown in the live race-detail 買い目の理由 tab.

Live final-ticket evidence prefers the immutable Worker final snapshot; if it does not exist, preserve the already-public final two tickets and fixed assumed odds and recompute only explanatory probability/value/score from the same frozen model and canonical feature-state rule. Never rewrite the published bets.
The data update timing panel remains compact and collapsed by default.
Historical race pages show runner/result details.
Confirmed bets are not presented as a horizontal swipe; courses are shown vertically and mobile ticket rows are card-like.
WIN5 is a first-class top navigation tab on every public HTML page; the old floating bottom-right WIN5 button must not be shown.
The WIN5 page uses two in-page buttons, 買い目 and その他; 買い目 is the default view and only one long view is shown at a time.
The WIN5 買い目 view shows target races and selected-horse tickets without a duplicate three-plan comparison block; detailed probabilities and recent-result reflection information are kept in その他.

The WIN5 その他 view shows only finalization/update metadata plus a permanently open section labeled in plain Japanese for each race's first-place prediction and recent-result reflection status; rule cards and duplicate rule notes are not shown.
WIN5 target races and ticket rows must remain readable on mobile without horizontal scrolling.
Past published picks and results are immutable.
Live race-bet generation is owned only by the isolated live-deadline Workers; the public-site Worker and public requests cannot create or finalize race bets.

Official JRA-odds previews begin from 90 minutes before post time, a preview is required by 30 minutes, normal immutable finalization is targeted by 25 minutes, the DB-only rescue guard operates from 20 to 15 minutes, and T-15 is a hard no-new-final boundary.

Primary live-deadline scheduling runs every minute and a separate staggered backup Worker runs every five minutes; a D1 lease prevents overlapping mutation while append-only preview archives preserve the newest last-good official preview.
JRA official odds are the only allowed market odds; synthetic, estimated, and probability-derived substitute odds are forbidden by both application validation and D1 final-state guards.
authoritativeRules: Read HANDOFF.md and this manifest before any continuation work.
Treat config/ten-year-completed-model.json as the canonical model specification.
Treat scripts/run-ten-year-auto-final-live.py as the canonical production betting entry.
Treat wrangler.jsonc.main as the canonical public-site entry.
Generate the Worker model asset from the canonical model and require model parity before production deploy.
Preserve the frozen 10-year archive selection identity: exactly five races per venue-day; settlement overlays may refine selected-race outcome states but must not promote canonical skips.
Do not re-select, retrain, revalidate, or replace the completed model unless the user explicitly asks to change the model.
Do not rewrite historical picks after publication.
Do not declare the handoff complete unless scripts/verify-canonical-handoff.py succeeds and emits CANONICAL_HANDOFF_OK on current main.

Treat src/live-deadline-entry-v2.ts plus wrangler.live-deadline.jsonc and wrangler.live-deadline-backup.jsonc as the canonical race-bet live scheduler; public-site requests must not mutate live race bets.
T-15 is a hard creation boundary: never create or backfill a new final race bet after fewer than 15 minutes remain before post time.
